exposure: HbA1c levels at diagnosis of gestational diabetes
cohort: 2048 Chinese women with gestational diabetes and singleton live births
finding: HbA1c levels at the time of gestational diabetes diagnosis were significantly associated with macrosomia, preterm birth, PIH, and primary C-section in Chinese women, with the strength of associations varying depending on maternal age, pre-pregnancy BMI, and gestational weight gain.
mod_finding: HbA1c levels at the time of gestational diabetes diagnosis were significantly associated with an increased risk of primary Cesarean section, with varying associations depending on maternal age and pre-pregnancy BMI.
